entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Sheikh Mohamed Laghdaf Stadium is a multi-use stadium located in Laayoune, Western Sahara, occupied by Morocco. It is used mostly for football matches. The stadium has a maximum capacity of 15,000 people and is home the JS Massira football club of Laayoune who plays in the Moroccan championship Botola.
